subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the four guard assertions are repaired, should these privileged GitHub Action revisions be accepted as one security-reviewed bundle?
rationale: The revisions execute third-party code in secret-bearing, publishing, scanning, and agent workflows, so final supply-chain trust acceptance requires human ownership.

options.title: Review and land bundle
options.body: Repair the guards, inspect each privileged revision, and merge after exact-head checks and security-owner approval.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Separate token, Docker publishing, CodeQL, and Codex updates into smaller independently reviewed trust boundaries.

options.title: Pause grouped update
options.body: Defer the bundle if direct source review cannot establish confidence in every privileged revision.

recommendation.title: Review and land bundle
recommendation.body: Repair the guards, inspect each privileged revision, and merge after exact-head checks and security-owner approval.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns the most security-sensitive changed workflows and focused guards to this team.
